snippet.title: Mistfall Hunter - Gameplay Deep Dive
snippet.description:
“When the mist descends, the gods turn their gaze away.”
Welcome to Mistfall Hunter — a land not meant to be conquered, but a graveyard of countless fallen deities.
Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy action extraction ARPG centered on survival and hunting. As a Gyldenhunter resurrected by Dew, you will be trapped in an endless cycle of life, death, and rebirth in this forsaken realm.
In this video, we break down the core rules that govern this world. You won’t just face grotesque twisted monsters — you’ll also have to navigate the deadly games of hunter ambition, betrayal, and deceit.

Add Mistfall Hunter to your Steam Wishlist and be the first to know what's coming next: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282300/Mistfall_Hunter/ 

Stay Connected:   
Official Website:https://mistfallhunter.com   
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mistfallhunter    
Contact: support@mail.mistfallhunter.com    

*Development Footage. Final Version May Vary.
